## Use case

What problem does the feature solve? Who hits this problem?

## Proposed shape

What would the API or behavior look like?

## Alternatives considered

What else did you try? Why is this the right approach?

## Scope check

Does this fit the v1 / v1.1 / v2 / v3 roadmap in `docs/requirements.md`?
If not, why should it land outside the planned scope?
